title: Revisiting the Transfinite Christensen-Pedersen Argument
summary: Christensen and Pedersen proved that every properly infinite $\mathrm{AW}^*$-algebra is monotone sequentially complete, and Saitô and Wright developed a transfinite form of their dilation argument. We revisit the transfinite construction using normality of $\mathrm{AW}^*$-algebras. Normality simplifies the limit stages by turning suprema into compressions of joins, so the construction only needs a supply of fresh orthogonal projections large enough to contain the supports of the summands at successor stages.
